preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of elements n in each test case must be between 3 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 100 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements in sequence a must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= 100 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements in sequence b must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c[i] <= 100 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements in sequence c must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] != b[i] and a[i] != c[i] and b[i] != c[i] for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: For each index i, a[i], b[i], and c[i] must be distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) in {a[i], b[i], c[i]} for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be one of the corresponding elements in sequences a, b, or c.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) != int(stdout.split()[(i + 1) % n]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent output integers must be equal, considering the circular adjacency.
